Game development: branded and casual 2D games

Casual 2D games for the browser, iPhone and Android, for your brand, your customers or as a product of your own. At a fixed price, below the market average.

Compared with the market

A simple mobile game typically starts at around €10,000 when you hire a studio in the Netherlands (Juego Studios, 2026). With us, a branded browser game starts at €1,950, a casual game at €4,950 and a 2D game with levels at €9,950. All prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added.

Games we made ourselves

We build and publish our own games too, so you can see what we make before you pay: Koffer Vol!, a packing puzzle with 100 levels in 10 countries, and Eiland Express, a 3D driving game on a tropical island. More on the projects page.

How it works

  1. Send us your logo, colours and the goal by email: a greeting, a contest or something for your team.
  2. Within 48 hours you get a free concept of the game.
  3. After you approve the design and the fixed price, we build it.
  4. You test it on your own phone, then share the link or QR code.

Frequently asked questions

Which games do you make?

Casual 2D games: puzzles, quizzes, reaction and arcade games. That can be a branded browser game for a campaign or trade show, a casual game for iPhone and Android, or a 2D game with levels and its own characters. Our own example is the puzzle game Koffer Vol!. We do not build large 3D games or online multiplayer.

Can I earn money with my game?

Yes. We can add ads or in-app purchases, such as extra levels, coins or removing ads, following Apple's and Google's rules; they keep a share of in-app purchase revenue. What works best depends on your players and your goal. In the concept we show how the revenue model fits the game without spoiling the fun.

Do players need to download an app?

Not for a branded game: it runs in the browser. Players open a link or scan a QR code, for example on a poster, packaging or in a newsletter, and play straight away, without installing anything or creating an account. If you do want an app in the stores, the casual game or the 2D game with levels is the right package.

Can the game be in my language?

Yes. The game can be in English, Dutch or another language, or in several languages at once. Our own game Koffer Vol! is available in 12 languages, for example. Tell us in your request which languages you need and we include them in the fixed price.

What does it cost after launch?

An extra level or game mode is from €395. Game maintenance with updates for new iOS and Android versions is €85.50 a month.
